title: Cond test stub missing Eq derive in jmap-types/query.rs
description: In crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs line 50, the Cond test stub derives PartialEq but not Eq. Since Filter<T>: Eq requires T: Eq, Filter<Cond> does not actually satisfy the Eq bound. The tests compile because assert_eq! only requires PartialEq+Debug. The fix is trivial: add Eq to the Cond derive. This is inconsistent with the structural guarantee that Filter<T> types are Eq.
